title: Logo-derived Figma style tokens and two one-page wireframe layouts
what: Extracts colours and fonts from a synthetic SVG logo into Figma-ready style tokens, then renders two distinct one-page wireframe layouts as desktop and mobile SVG frames with an HTML preview.
shows: Palette and type scale derived from a logo, WCAG contrast checked, and two layouts (hero-first vs story-scroll) with tradeoff notes, ready for the page-goal discussion.
checks: palette and fonts match the known logo values
contrast of white on black equals 21 and token pairs pass AA
layouts differ and frame heights equal section sums; SVGs parse
done: Figma tokens: colours, type scale, spacing
Two wireframe layouts, desktop and mobile
HTML preview checked in headless browser
remaining: Apply to the real logo files
High-fidelity Figma frames with real copy
limits: Synthetic placeholder logo; wireframes are low-fidelity SVGs, not native Figma files; no real copy, imagery or high-fidelity visual design yet.
